name: The Last Leviathan Song
introDiscord:
A low song passes through the graveyard.

Not through the water.

Through the bones.

Every skeleton in the Wake seems to remember the same melody.
introTwitch:
A low song passes through the graveyard.

Not through the water.

Through the bones.

Every skeleton in the Wake seems to remember the same melody.

the-last-leviathan-song-approach.prompt: Three paths follow the ancient resonance.

left.message: A Songwake Phantom forms inside the vibration of a rib.

right.message: A strongbox rests where the song is quietest.

forward.message:
Shizuki's old camp contains one bottle and a note:

'Heard song all night.

Didn't feel dangerous.

Just lonely.'
forward.fullHpMessage:
You leave the restorative.

The song continues.

the-last-leviathan-song-depths.prompt: The melody passes from skeleton to skeleton.

left.message: Star Candies rest inside a hollow vertebra humming with the song.

right.message: A Phantom condenses from the resonance.

forward.message:
One Berry rests beneath Shizuki's journal:

'Glimmer stopped chiming and listened.

We sat here for a while.

I think this place remembers them.'

the-last-leviathan-song-threshold.prompt: Resonance Grave lies where the song becomes clearest.

left.message:
A mineral spring rests beneath an enormous rib.

Shizuki wrote:

'Not every quiet thing needs a joke.

Rest here.'
left.fullHpMessage: You leave the spring untouched and listen.

right.message: A navigator's chest rests beneath the singing bones.

forward.message: A Songwake Phantom emerges from the final note.

bossPromptDiscord:
The graveyard falls silent.

Then one voice sings alone.

The sound is impossibly deep—larger than anything still living here.

A shape forms from light and memory inside Resonance Grave.

Use /yes to enter the Grave or /no to leave the final song undisturbed.
bossPromptTwitch:
The graveyard falls silent.

Then one voice sings alone.

The sound is impossibly deep—larger than anything still living here.

A shape forms from light and memory inside Resonance Grave.

Use !yes to enter the Grave or !no to leave the final song undisturbed.
bossRetreatText:
You step back.

The ancient song resumes softly.

boss.revealText:
The resonance gathers into an immense spectral presence.

Primordial Voice reveals itself!

completionText:
The Primordial Voice fades.

One final note travels through every skeleton in Leviathan's Wake.

Then silence.

Whatever sang first is gone.

But the Wake remembered.
